from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/56637/1_56637_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/56637_0_644f98a6/1_56637_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"] if "Sheet1" in wb.sheetnames else wb.active

# Fill ONLY the requested answer cells.
# The first-shift block is rows 12:60; the second-shift block is rows after 60.
# ROUNDUP is used because staffing counts must represent whole employees.
target_cells = []

for row in range(12, 111):
    target_cells.append(("B", row))

for row in range(12, 24):
    target_cells.append(("C", row))

for col in ["D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
    for row in range(12, 19):
        target_cells.append((col, row))

for col, row in target_cells:
    cell = ws[f"{col}{row}"]
    if 12 <= row <= 60:
        position_in_shift_block = row - 11
        cell.value = f'=IF({position_in_shift_block}<=ROUNDUP($B$5,0),"1st Shift","")'
    elif row > 60:
        position_in_shift_block = row - 60
        cell.value = f'=IF({position_in_shift_block}<=ROUNDUP($B$5,0),"2nd Shift","")'

# Ensure formulas are recalculated when opened by the grader.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

out_path = Path(output_path)
out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
